# ONTO: June-origin conditional common-allocation addendum v3
Research cutoff: 18 October 2026. Currency USD; amounts in millions except per-share amounts. Original v1/v2 research and audits are preserved. This is a claims-only extension, not another operating-model build or publication authorization.

## Recommendation
**Ready for a clearly dated operating-EV presentation and explicit conditional common-allocation calculator. Not ready for a single accepted intrinsic per-share value or current price target.** Missing October balances do not prevent a retrospective June-origin scenario. The existing operating audit remains the governing qualified pass: 110 checks, 40 retained raw-source hashes, 262 SEC facts and 191 annual-document observations. Those frozen operating checks were not rerun or represented as new assurance here.

Display operating EVs first: downcycle $2,642.612m, base $5,867.222m, upside $10,231.558m. Explain that these analyst scenarios use a June cash-flow origin with October discount inputs, rather than a point-in-time June estimate. Preserve the 20bp occupancy-headroom sensitivity: base EV $5,820.833m, a $46.389m reduction. It remains a stress, not measured incremental rent.

Q2 2026 is the latest report retained and reviewed here. The independent v3 audit did not verify freshness of the live quarterly-results page. Q3 $380–400m revenue and 31.5–32.5% adjusted operating-margin figures remain management guidance. The model’s $420m Q4 and $850m H1 2027 assumptions remain analyst inputs. Preserve all three prior dated guidance/actual comparisons, including GAAP EPS misses and acquisition-scope caveats. No new forecasting-accuracy conclusion is justified.

## What can be resolved now
1. **June common stock is a reported rounded amount, not an arbitrary denominator.** The equity rollforward is 49.702 + 0.073 − 0.031 + 0.124 − 0.805 − 0.030 = 49.033m. July 31’s 49.074247m shares and EPS-weighted diluted counts are different dated concepts. Adding hypothetical 0.750m legacy full-value equivalents gives the previously illustrated 49.783m denominator; only the added legacy claim is unmeasured. Source: preserved [Q2 balance sheet and equity statement](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/704532/000119312526338401/onto-20260630.htm).
2. **Cash/convert bridge arithmetic is reproducible.** Cash plus securities 1,882.150, less analyst operating reserve 33.60411, less disclosed June convertible fair value 1,982.250, less known unpaid financing/excise costs 4.669, gives −138.37311 before the remaining assets/claims. Principal 1,500 and carrying value 1,471.731 are not additional deductions. The 500 bridge commitment was terminated, not an additional funded 500 debt. Preserve the unpaid bridge issuance cost within 4.669. Source: Q2 Notes 3/7 and cash-flow supplement, retained in original research.
3. **FX accounting category is resolved, but economic netting is not.** The 1.284 forward asset sits in prepaid/other current assets, outside cash/securities. These forwards economically hedge foreign-currency transactions but are not accounting-designated hedges; remeasurement goes to other income/expense. Currency-level exposure, tax and settlements are not specified sufficiently to assert a net benefit. Keep a separately visible zero credit in the illustrative bridge, plus a gross unoffset 1.284 stress, rather than hiding it in residual claims. Source: retained Q2 Note 5, freshly checked against the SEC page.

## New Rigaku primary evidence
The [April 21 issuer disclosure, page 3](https://contents.xj-storage.jp/xcontents/AS08865/109fc74d/4ce7/4816/a1d2/3eb9ea4b4ae1/140120260420507008.pdf) supplies more than the previous board-seat summary:
- Transfers/disposals need Rigaku’s prior written consent during an unspecified restriction period.
- Additional acquisitions, acquisition proposals and certain voting agreements are restricted during that period.
- In principle, Onto has subscription rights to maintain its ratio upon new issuance, while holding at least half of the originally acquired shares.
- The right to recommend one non-executive director also depends on that half-holding threshold.
These are minority rights; there is no supported control premium or cost-equals-value inference. The publicly disclosed period is not quantified here, so no invented lock-up expiry or numerical liquidity discount is used.

A new [September 30 Rigaku disclosure](https://contents.xj-storage.jp/xcontents/AS08865/2fe491d4/0d27/408d/9310/f6b54039e90f/140120260930542508.pdf) announces a September 29 agreement to transfer all 61,123,436 shares to wholly owned Onto Innovation Japan, with completion scheduled for October 1. It reports 26.99% of voting rights using August 31 voting rights, and says the Japanese subsidiary joined the alliance agreement with Rigaku’s consent. The parent would hold the same shares indirectly. This is not evidence of a sale outside the consolidated group or another $720m external purchase. Completion itself is not independently established from this forward-dated notice alone. Do not confuse percentage-denominator changes with a disposal.

Onto’s [August closing announcement](https://investors.ontoinnovation.com/news/news-details/2026/Onto-Innovation-Completes-Strategic-Investment-in-Rigaku-Holdings-Corporation/default.aspx) confirms fair-value-option accounting and no consolidation. Its yen wording contains an apparent extra “billion”; use the preserved SEC filing’s transaction amount and share count, not literal multiplication of that typo. The approx. $720m acquisition price remains historical consideration, not a current quote or intrinsic stake value.

For an October-origin bridge, first reconcile actual post-June cash and measure the stake on that origin; do not subtract the purchase again if it is already reflected in cash. For the existing June-origin model, keep paired future purchase/asset legs. Represent their **net June present value as a separate unknown parameter**. A zero parameter is the at-cost illustrative convention, not an assertion that minority risk has disappeared. The old 70%/120% cost sensitivities retain their explicit same-rate convention and are not a fair-value interval. A future measured market mark needs same-date Rigaku share price, JPY/USD, confirmation of shares/rights and relevant tax treatment; none is inferred from acquisition cost. A Rigaku fundamental DCF would be a separate research scope.

## Reproducible conditional allocation
Using the frozen June convertible claim:

Conditional common value per share = (Operating EV − 138.37311 + capped-call value + private-investment recovery − residual claims − ESPP claim + net Rigaku present value + net FX adjustment) / (49.033 + legacy full-value-equivalent units).

Each amount is in USD millions, shares in millions. The convertible claim is held fixed across the operating cases; an intrinsic security repricing would need a consistent equity/option model. Do not also add convertible shares. Do not add both a capped-call asset and a second dilution offset. The already-paid 88.95 premium is not deducted again. Fresh-grant cost remains in operating margins and is not charged again as dilution.

For comparison only, retain the prior illustration: capped-call proxy 88.95; private recovery 8; residual claims 15; ESPP 3; legacy units 0.750; net Rigaku PV and FX adjustment zero. **These are transparent demonstration inputs, not best estimates.** With the identical bridge in each operating case the results are $51.89 / $116.66 / $204.33. The prior $47.57 downside includes an additional 70%-of-cost Rigaku stress; it is not the same claims bridge as the other two. Preserve it as a combined downside, with that distinction visible.

At the middle operating case, changing only capped-call credit from 88.95 to zero lowers the demonstration by $1.79/share; nominal unchanged-contract cap stress raises it $8.26. Legacy units 0.4/1.2 instead of 0.75 move it +$0.83/−$1.05. A ±100 convertible claim change moves it ∓$2.01. The Rigaku 70% cost stress reduces it $4.32, whereas gross unoffset FX credit adds only $0.026. These are isolated arithmetic sensitivities, not probable ranges. No scenario probability, current quote comparison or trading recommendation is supplied.

## Remaining gates and practical next step
- Dated denominator: June rounded common is resolved; legacy service/performance awards, payout equivalents, forfeitures, deferred awards and current ESPP rights remain estimates. January award counts or June unrecognized expense cannot substitute.
- Convertible/capped calls: June market claim is disclosed and usable conditionally. Capped-call model parameters, full executed allocations, settlement/event interactions, credit and tax effects remain unmeasured. No defensible single asset fair value emerged from available primary sources.
- Taxes/capital payables/deferred compensation: the earlier $15m allowance remains unmeasured, with no reason to rebrand it as reported. Ordinary operating liabilities already reflected in funded cash flows must not be subtracted twice. Do not grant face-value DTA credits or double-count gross and recorded UTBs.
- FX: accounting classification closed; net economics open. Low numerical sensitivity is not measurement closure.
- Rigaku: ownership/rights evidence improved materially; unrestricted liquidity, a contemporaneous mark and intrinsic minority value are not established. Private investment carrying value likewise is not fair value.
- Occupancy: retain existing stress and unresolved old/new premises reconciliation.

**Integration choice:** dated EV-first case is defensible now. A visible conditional calculator is also defensible if all unmeasured claims and dates remain exposed. Do not select $116.66 as a validated base target merely because it reproduces. No current-equity fields are filled. Revisit actual new filings and contract/award disclosures when available; no outreach or future monitoring was initiated.

## Artifacts and preservation
Run `python claims-addendum-v3/replay.py` from any directory. It uses standard library arithmetic, verifies key facts exist in the retained Q2 text, independently reconciles common shares and fixed claims, and writes `calculation.json`. It does not execute original builders. `source-ledger.json` records new raw-source URLs, retrieval times and hashes; `input-preservation.json` fingerprints preserved pre-existing files; `manifest.json` inventories this addendum. Original research, independent audits and public-safe packets were not edited. No Site was edited or published. This addendum still needs independent reviewer acceptance before parent integration.
